projects.name: PacketSentry
projects.category: Deep Packet Inspection and Traffic Analysis
projects.description: A security-focused Deep Packet Inspection and traffic analysis system for parsing PCAP traffic, tracking flows, inspecting protocols, evaluating rules, detecting suspicious behavior, and generating structured reports.
key_features: Packet parsing across Ethernet, IP, TCP and UDP layers
projects.contribution: Designed and developed the complete application independently.
projects.hardest_part: Correlating information across multiple protocol layers and designing a reliable pipeline that connects packet, flow, DNS, HTTP and TLS metadata to identify application-level traffic and suspicious behavior.
future_improvements: Improved handling of encrypted traffic metadata

projects.name: PharmaGuard
projects.description: A full-stack pharmacogenomic analysis platform that processes VCF files, performs deterministic risk analysis, and generates AI-assisted plain-language explanations.
projects.contribution: Designed and developed the full-stack application independently, including the FastAPI backend, VCF processing workflow, deterministic risk analysis, AI explanation layer, React frontend and deployment.
projects.hardest_part: Separating deterministic clinical risk analysis from AI-generated explanations so that the language model explains the analysis rather than determining the underlying risk result.

projects.name: NyaySetu
projects.description: An AI-assisted legal intelligence platform supporting document analysis, legal summarization, contextual legal retrieval and simplified legal explanations.
key_features: Custom dataset containing 50+ IPC sections and legal entries
projects.contribution: Built the complete frontend and dashboard workflow and contributed to parts of the backend implementation and data flow.
projects.hardest_part: Designing a frontend that presents retrieved legal information, summaries and AI-generated explanations in a way that remains understandable despite the complexity of the underlying legal content.

projects.name: My Corner in Matrix
projects.description: A personal portfolio website built from core web technologies with a Matrix-inspired cyberpunk aesthetic, glassmorphism UI, interactive animations, and a custom terminal-style interface for exploring projects and profile information.
projects.contribution: Designed and developed the complete portfolio website independently, including the interface, visual system, animations, terminal interaction and deployment.
projects.hardest_part: Creating an immersive interface and interactive terminal experience using only core web technologies while keeping the website lightweight and fast.
future_improvements: Add richer project interaction and case-study pages
Introduce a more dynamic content management approach

projects.name: ASCII Art Video Player
projects.description: A Python terminal application that converts video frames into ASCII characters and plays the resulting animation directly in the terminal.
key_features: Supports video formats handled by OpenCV
projects.contribution: Designed and developed the complete application independently.
projects.hardest_part: Converting video frames into readable ASCII output while maintaining a usable playback experience in a terminal, including frame processing, brightness mapping and configurable display dimensions.
